originalLicenseNote: Engine source under MIT; embeds the network eval-ml-8-152B-spsa.pnn from https://github.com/Witek902/Caissa-Nets (MIT, as its README states for every network file), trained on the engine's self-play games.
blurb: Caissa 2.0 is the September 2026 release of Michał Witanowski's MIT-licensed C++ UCI chess engine, written from scratch since 2021 and trained on its own self-play games. It pairs magic bitboards, singular, double and triple extensions, ProbCut, razoring, null-move, late-move and history pruning, and pawn, non-pawn and continuation correction histories with an embedded NNUE of 32 king buckets, a 1536-wide pairwise accumulator and 8 output buckets. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper, with its net on the portable path that clang vectorizes to WebAssembly SIMD.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build on the C poll helper, with the search on the UCI thread and Threads fixed to 1; built by hand with the flags of CMake's Final configuration; the net runs on the engine's portable path, vectorized by clang to 128-bit WebAssembly SIMD, with node counts equal to the native AVX2 build's; denormals are kept, where the native build flushes them; no Syzygy tablebases; Hash capped at 1024 MB.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: Magic bitboards for slider attacks, with a BMI2 PEXT path natively.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Principal variation search with iterative deepening and MultiPV.

features.label: Aspiration Windows
features.implementation: Windows scaled by the score, widened on each fail.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Null-move pruning; at high depth a null-move fail-high reduces the node's depth instead of cutting.

features.label: Razoring
features.implementation: Quiescence verification at low depth when the eval is far below alpha.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Capture search against a raised beta, also in check, guided by the hash entry.

features.label: Internal Iterative Reductions
features.implementation: One ply less from depth 3 without a deep enough hash entry.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Singular, double and triple extensions, with negative extensions on cut nodes and fail-highs.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Table reductions adjusted by history statistics and node type.

features.label: Late-Move & History Pruning
features.implementation: Late-move, history and futility pruning in the moves loop.

features.label: Quiescence Search
features.implementation: Captures with futility pruning in leaf nodes.

features.label: Histories & Correction
features.implementation: Quiet and continuation histories with killer and counter moves, plus pawn, non-pawn and continuation correction histories.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Clusters of three entries with generations, bounds and static evals.

features.label: NNUE
features.implementation: Embedded integer net: 32 king buckets of 768 inputs, 1536-wide accumulator with pairwise clipped ReLU, sparse first layer, then 16, 32 and 1 in 8 output buckets.
